newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Vranitzky to resign - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Vranitzky to resign - spokesman.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Franz Vranitzky will offer his resignation on Saturday, his spokesman said.
"Chancellor Franz Vranitzky will offer his resignation," his spokesman Karl Krammer told Reuters.

Krammer was reached by telephone inside the headquarters of Vranitzky's Social Democratic Party, where senior party leaders had convened for an emergency meeting amid growing expectations that Vranitzky would announce his resignation.
Vranitzky, 59, was quoted by Austrian television as saying that his successor had not yet been decided.
Austrian media earlier reported Vranitzky was expected to be succeeded by fellow Social Democrat and Finance Minister Viktor Klima, 49.
Krammer said he could not comment on the reports, but added: "Klima would be an appropriate candidate".
